name: jfc-host-portal
description: JFC Host — standalone web-only portal (React + Vite) for the 'desk' half of the Host experience (KYH onboarding, event wizard, payouts, disputes). The 'floor' half (live dashboard, scanner, bar terminal) is jfc-host-app (Expo/React Native). See ../ui-ai/design_handoff_justforcpls/01-architecture.md's "Shared UI libraries" section — this app is a Yarn workspace member alongside jfc-admin-portal and jfc-support-portal, not a copy of either.
